title: Visible full coils along one spring wire
question: How many full coils are visible in the single blue spring? Count one coil for each complete top-to-bottom-to-top cycle while following the wire from left to right. Do not count a partial cycle at either end.

task_signature.mechanism: Follow one connected oscillating wire and count complete top-to-bottom-to-top cycles between visibly level endpoints.

latent_z.description: A sampled full-cycle count and nuisance geometry determine one continuous blue spring trace with level endpoint stubs.

latent_alias.justification: Every declared scene field changes rendered pixels, and the only field used by analytic gold is the visibly instantiated coil_count.

boundary.observable: Each full coil is one complete visible top-bottom-top traversal; both endpoint stubs lie on the same top level so partial end cycles are explicit.
boundary.quarantine: Scenes are quarantined if pixel recovery loses connectivity, extrema separation, endpoint-level agreement, or runner-up count margin.

semantic_contrast.contrast: Unlike trident terminal counting, arch counting against a guide, row traversal counting, or a binary alternation check, this mechanism has no branches or endpoints to enumerate: it follows a single curved wire and composes paired opposite extrema into complete periodic cycles with explicitly level terminal phases.
semantic_contrast.expected_information_gain: It isolates whether a model overrides an iconic regular-spring prior by integrating all visible cycles of one long connected trace.
